entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 72
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 37562 of 2022
Applicant :- Raj Kumar And 3 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Rai,Anjani Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Deepak Mishra, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent
are present.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been moved with a prayer to quash charge-sheet dated 07.09.2020, cognizance order dated 06.08.2022 and the entire proceedings of Case No.4455 of 2022 (State Vs. Sachin and others) arising out of Case Crime No.55 of 2020, under Sections 323,
498A, 504 & 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Nagal, District Bijnor,
pending in the court of Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division)/ Judicial Magistrate, Najibabad,
District Bijnor.

entities.text: Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Nagal, District Bijnor
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text:
Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division)/ Judicial Magistrate, Najibabad,
District Bijnor
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the Court, learned counsel for the applicants only submitted that some direction be issued to the court concerned regarding bail as the applicants want to surrender before the trial court.

The application is, therefore, disposed of with the direction to the trial court that if the applicants appear before the trial court within 15 days from today and move an application for bail before the trial court, the same shall be decided as soon as possible in view of law laid down in Satender Kumar Raj Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110194413/
1 Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2021) 10 SCC 773 and Brahm Singh and others Vs. State of U.P. and others, 2016 (95) ACC 950.
